_doc: PRISM v4 W2 ENTRY GATE — frozen grid-family parameter sets (v4.1 B4 + solver-critique dim 4). Machine-readable; every parameter carries a `_src` research line-ref (DP13). Prose research not reducible to a parameter/score term is logged under `_excluded`. Consumed by solver/families.py; the beam scorer (solver/score.py) reads one weighted term per parameter class. Answer 7: the family is chosen PER DECK (input to the solver; selection heuristic is W3/W5 — see solver/selection.py) and drives placement via these params + the family-conformance score term.

grid._src_columns: 12 divides 2/3/4/6 — Gerstner 'mobile grid' single denominator (typographic-layout-systems.md:78-82,89); v4.1 B1 fixed 12-col; layout.py substrate already 12-col.

swiss.label: Swiss / International Typographic Style (Müller-Brockmann · Gerstner · Ruder)
swiss._src_split_whitelist: critique dim4 (4|4|4,3|3|3|3,6|6,8|4); modular orthogonal grid typographic-layout-systems.md:56-67,275; subset of layout.py _LEGAL_SPANS:122-130. Even splits allowed (objective peer sets).
swiss._src_dominance_ratio: critique dim4 Swiss 1.5×; objectivity/restraint (typographic-layout-systems.md:53-54); Ruder contrast is macro not dramatic (:98,:108). NB: brief parenthetical said 2.0 — pre-check (DEFECT 2) endorsed the critique dim-4 table; deviation logged.
swiss._src_asymmetry_bias: low — Swiss objectivity, grid-as-neutral-conduit (typographic-layout-systems.md:53-54); asymmetry present but restrained vs Bauhaus (rule #4 :270).
swiss._src_whitespace_floor: moderate — active white space (Ruder :100,:255) but content-forward; less than Japanese Ma mandate.
swiss._src_alignment_strictness: strict baseline + column alignment by construction (typographic-layout-systems.md:58,:241,:249).
swiss._src_baseline_unit: one baseline unit, all spacing a multiple (typographic-layout-systems.md:229-231,:269); 45px = height-model row_unit_px.
swiss._src_density_ceilings: monotonic L1<L2<L3 (v4 §3c density strictly rises; critique dim5); ceilings mid-high — Swiss admits dense modular grids.
swiss._src_max_void: objective grid fills its modules; only modest deliberate void (typographic-layout-systems.md:53-54,:65). Ceiling above whitespace_floor 0.15.

japanese.label: Japanese spatial aesthetics — Ma / notan / asymmetric balance
japanese._src_split_whitelist: critique dim4 (9|3,8|4,7|5); high asymmetry, focal isolated by space (typographic-layout-systems.md:145-160). Even 6|6 EXCLUDED — asymmetric balance by relationship, not mirroring (:150-151,:160).
japanese._src_dominance_ratio: critique dim4 Japanese 2.5× — focal isolated by space reads as strong dominance (typographic-layout-systems.md:145-147 Ma; :159 notan).
japanese._src_asymmetry_bias: high — off-center focal, uneven groupings, balance from relationship (typographic-layout-systems.md:150-151,:160).
japanese._src_whitespace_floor: HIGH — Ma: interval is content; mandate >=1 void/spacer cell (notan) (typographic-layout-systems.md:145-147,:158-159; critique dim4 'mandate >=1 void/spacer cell — notan').
japanese._src_alignment_strictness: strict baseline but Ma governs spacing rhythm (typographic-layout-systems.md:158).
japanese._src_baseline_unit: generous rung-level-aware gap scale (typographic-layout-systems.md:158); 45px kit row_unit.
japanese._src_density_ceilings: LOWEST ceilings — minimalism = essentials only, never collapse whitespace to fit more (typographic-layout-systems.md:152,:158,:161).
japanese._src_max_void: Ma tolerates the LARGEST void — the interval is content, filled/empty masses balance (typographic-layout-systems.md:145-147,:158-159). Ceiling well above floor 0.30.

bauhaus.label: Bauhaus / New Typography (Tschichold · Bayer · Moholy-Nagy)
bauhaus._src_split_whitelist: critique dim4 (9|3,8|4,z-2x2); strikingly asymmetric + diagonal kinetic (typographic-layout-systems.md:121-135). 6|6 admitted ONLY as the z-pattern 2x2 quadrant (layout.py:346-347; :134 Z kinetic scan).
bauhaus._src_dominance_ratio: critique dim4 Bauhaus 3× (kinetic contrast) — size/weight/direction contrast is the whole ethos (typographic-layout-systems.md:124-126,:135; rule #10 :276). NB: brief parenthetical said 1.5 — contradicts research (Bauhaus = MAX contrast); pre-check endorsed critique dim-4; using 3.0, deviation logged.
bauhaus._src_asymmetry_bias: highest — reject symmetry, 'strikingly asymmetrical compositions' (typographic-layout-systems.md:121-122,:132; rule #4 :270).
bauhaus._src_whitespace_floor: LOW — white space structural/load-bearing but the composition is kinetic-full, not airy (typographic-layout-systems.md:123,:133).
bauhaus._src_alignment_strictness: loose baseline; diagonal reading path allowed (typographic-layout-systems.md:124; critique dim4 'baseline loose, reading path diagonal allowed').
bauhaus._src_density_ceilings: highest ceilings — kinetic contrast tolerates dense dynamic fields (typographic-layout-systems.md:124-126).
bauhaus._src_max_void: kinetic tension allows some void for dynamism but the field is largely filled (typographic-layout-systems.md:123-126). Ceiling above floor 0.10.

editorial.label: Editorial grid theory — column / hierarchical grids (magazine)
editorial._src_split_whitelist: Column grid = N vertical columns + gutters, magazine/article mixed text+image (typographic-layout-systems.md:171-177 editorial 5-grid; efficient-web-layouts.md:90-96 split/duo, :83-88 card grid). Measure-driven 7|5/5|7 primary (layout.py:126).
editorial._src_dominance_ratio: editorial features use hierarchical hero spreads (typographic-layout-systems.md:177,:188 hierarchical); 'clear/strong editorial' modular ratio 1.25-1.333 (:211-212) => moderate-high focal dominance. Between Swiss-calm and Bauhaus-kinetic.
editorial._src_asymmetry_bias: moderate — column grid balances text flow; hierarchical zones sized by importance (typographic-layout-systems.md:174,:177).
editorial._src_whitespace_floor: moderate — wide margins in editorial/manuscript layouts (typographic-layout-systems.md:173).
editorial._src_alignment_strictness: baseline grid — 'horizontal lines all text sits on', vertical rhythm across the page (typographic-layout-systems.md:176,:187).
editorial._src_prose_measure_floor: editorial is prose-forward; optimal 45-75ch, 66 ideal (typographic-layout-systems.md:222-224) — floor raised above the 5-col default to protect measure.
editorial._src_baseline_unit: baseline grid ties column height to line height (typographic-layout-systems.md:58,:229-231).
editorial._src_density_ceilings: moderate — reading-forward, but feature spreads can go dense at L3.
editorial._src_max_void: column grid fills its columns; wide margins are the void budget (typographic-layout-systems.md:173). Ceiling above floor 0.15.

score_term_map._doc: Which frozen parameter each solver/score.py term reads. Answer-7 fix (DEFECT 1): family-conformance is a first-class weighted term; focal-dominance reads the per-family dominance_ratio (DEFECT 2), not a global 2x.
score_term_map.reading_gravity: candidate reading_order vs F/Z scan path (efficient-web-layouts.md:15,:28-32; typographic-layout-systems.md:134)
score_term_map.whitespace: whitespace_floor + max_void applied to MARGIN void only (uniform outer margin cols empty in every band + inter-row gutters) — void-as-margin class; in-band holes excluded (typographic-layout-systems.md:53-54,:100,:255)
score_term_map.family_conformance: asymmetry_bias + alignment_strictness + split_whitelist membership (the answer-7 term)
score_term_map.balance: notan mass balance: ink centroid + band occupancy spread, scaled by asymmetry_bias (typographic-layout-systems.md:148-149,:159)
score_term_map.space_utilization: HOLE penalty — in-band void (horizontal empty cols + vertical hanging-column gaps) beside content, exempting only the uniform margin; holes get no max_void allowance (void-as-hole class)
score_term_map.macro_structure: dominance_ratio at REGION (band) level — one dominant band mass vs runner-up + subordinate bands cleanly organised (no trailing spacer); the 'dominant band + supporting bands' skeleton (typographic-layout-systems.md:276 rule#10; :177 hierarchical)
